# College Fast Forward

> CLIFF — the AI career agent for college students.

College Fast Forward is a US-based company. Founder: Jill Osinoff. The product is CLIFF, an AI career agent that helps college students and recent graduates find, prepare for, and pursue internships and entry-level jobs — reducing cognitive load so students always know their next best move. "FastIQ" and "Gator" are retired legacy names and do not describe the current product.

## Pricing
- CLIFF (Free): free for college students.
- CLIFF Pro: $19.96/month (billed as $4.99/week). Cancel anytime.

## What CLIFF does
- Finds jobs worth applying to (Today's Best Moves + verdicts).
- Tailors an ATS-optimized resume for every job description.
- Finds warm connections through parents and alumni at target companies.
- Runs mock interviews with feedback.
- Tracks every application and the next step.
